- [October 2026]{.item-date} Research stay at Transducens, Universitat d'Alacant, opened with a kickoff talk, [Fuzzy Matches and Synthetic Data for Machine Translation](talks/alicante-2026/).
- [October 2026]{.item-date} Our [WMT 2026 submission](publications/2026-wmt-sorbian.qmd) for multitask Sorbian NLP was the joint winner of the Sorbian track at the Conference on Machine Translation (WMT).
- [September 2026]{.item-date} At CLIN 36 in Brussels, gave an oral presentation, [Synthetic Data for Machine Translation](talks/clin2026.pdf), and presented the [SanreMello Corpus](publications/2026-clin36-sanremello.qmd) poster, seven decades of Sanremo and Melodifestivalen as data.
- [August 2026]{.item-date} Our [EAMT 2026 paper](publications/2026-eamt.qmd) on machine translation in the asylum context is now published in the [ACL Anthology](https://aclanthology.org/2026.eamt-1.3/).
- [July 2026]{.item-date} Taught the five-day Introduction to Python module at the MILS summer school (Methods in Language Sciences), Ghent University.
- [June 2026]{.item-date} Presented our [EAMT 2026 paper](publications/2026-eamt.qmd) on machine translation in the asylum context, shortlisted for a best-paper award.
- [May 2026]{.item-date} [ShAnEL-2](publications/2026-lrec-shanel.qmd), our multilingual short-answer grading dataset, was accepted at LREC 2026.
- [March 2026]{.item-date} Our [study on fuzzy retrieval for automated grading](publications/2026-clinj-grading.qmd) appeared in the Computational Linguistics in the Netherlands Journal.
